Applied by scripts/migrate/content/titles-meta.mjs, last in the run. Each row names the page, the field Google reads (title, meta or h1), the document and the field that sets it, the value Google shows today (old) and the approved value (new). Rows with "hold" are approved but held back (the wave 2 cities): they are checked, not applied. migration/seo-intentional-changes.json, which the parity gate reads, must list exactly these values. See README.md section 10. Decision D18 (owner, 2026-10-19) adds 15 rows: the title, meta and H1 of three new service pages (`added`: old is null, the allowlist holds them under `added`) and the retitles of /services/fixture-replacements and /services/exterior-electrical.
